Cikuya Station

LocationCentral Transit Corridor
CategoryPublic Transportation
ClientMetropolitan Rail & Transport Corporation
Project Scale115,000 sq.ft.
Duration12 Months
ScopeRoad & Miscellaneous Civil Works
Project Case Study

Subterranean vaulted transit infrastructure engineered for non-stop traffic.

High-capacity subterranean transit platform engineered with coffered vaulted arches and durable civil treatments.

Cikuya Station represents high-capacity public transit engineering at its most intricate. Serving thousands of commuters daily, our team delivered subterranean negative-side waterproofing, vault ceiling rehabilitation, durable pedestrian floor polishing, and heavy-duty civil masonry.

The subterranean location required rigorous damp-proof injections and micro-cement masonry repair, followed by specialized vapor-permeable anti-fungal coatings that prevent moisture condensation on vaulted ceiling ribs.

Key Engineering & Execution Highlights

  • Negative-side hydrostatic pressure waterproofing in underground tunnels
  • Restoration and protective coating of historic coffered concrete ceiling arches
  • Abrasion-resistant epoxy road and concourse surface treatments
  • Round-the-clock nocturnal execution maintaining uninterrupted rail operations
